command.configureClangd: Preview and Enable clangd Scope Configuration
command.restoreClangd: Preview and Remove clangd Scope Configuration
setting.navigationBackend: Definition, symbol and reference strategy: auto prefers language services, then basic C fallback; local uses C syntax only; languageService uses installed providers. See the support matrix for empty reference behavior.
setting.queryTimeoutMs: Explicit query timeout in milliseconds. Automatic definitions wait up to 500ms for semantics before bounded C fallback. Timed-out underlying work retains its concurrency slot.
setting.workspaceSymbolTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for language-service workspace symbols (ms). Increase for large Java or Python projects.
setting.autoPreview: Preview the selected symbol definition automatically after the cursor settles.
setting.autoRelation: Follow the current function in Relation when unlocked.
setting.contextLines: Lines before and after the Context target.
setting.files.exclude: Extra project-file exclusion globs. Supports *, ?, ** and respects files.exclude.
setting.files.include: Project-file include globs. An empty array includes all files.
setting.sourceInsightKeys: Opt in to Source Insight keys: Alt+=, Alt+comma, Alt+period, Shift+F12 and Alt+F8 / Alt+Shift+F8. Disabled by default.
setting.contextMode: Preview the symbol definition/declaration, an explicit type definition, or the enclosing function. Variables and fields keep their own definitions by default.
setting.symbolKinds: Show all symbols, including includes, macros, globals, types and functions, or functions and their containers only.
setting.layout: Automatically show Context / Relation on startup while preserving existing view positions. Apply the reading layout explicitly to reveal the other reading views. Native panel position and alignment remain under user control.
setting.explorerSide: Primary sidebar location when a reading layout is applied explicitly. Preserve keeps the current side.
enum.explorerSide.left: Place primary sidebar on the left
enum.explorerSide.right: Place primary sidebar on the right
setting.relationBackend: Call relation backend. auto tries the language service then C syntax fallback. Local C does not evaluate preprocessor conditions or infer indirect calls.
enum.relationBackend.auto: Prefer language service, then local C fallback
setting.indexExclude: Local C index exclusion glob. Changes trigger a rescan; Rebuild Local C Index forces content verification.
setting.relationView: Horizontal graph shows direct callers and callees. Outline supports recursive expansion.
enum.relationView.horizontalGraph: Direct callers → current function → direct callees
setting.textLookupExclude: Extra text-search exclusion glob. Also respects files.exclude and search.exclude entries set to true.
setting.symbolHighlightUseF2: Opt in to F2 same-name text highlighting, replacing Rename. F8, Ctrl+Alt+H and commands remain available.
setting.relationLocalTimeoutMs: Single local call relation timeout (ms); index building does not block forever.
setting.relationRetryDelayMs: Automatic retry cooldown after two timeouts for the same workspace/language/direction (ms). Manual refresh retries immediately.
setting.indexEnabled: Enable the local C index for symbols, definitions, bound references and calls, independently of Relation backend.
setting.excludedDirectories: Exclude directory subtrees before scanning. Supports workspace-relative paths, absolute paths within roots and URIs.
setting.autoConfigureClangd: Opt in to managed .clangd exclusion blocks. Use the preview command first. Originals are backed up; disabling removes only the managed block.
setting.excludedFiles: Exclude selected files. Use Shift or Ctrl/Cmd selection in Project Files.
setting.appearance.panes: Per-view fonts, sizes, foreground and background. Empty values inherit the theme. Edit in Settings > Appearance.
manifest.description: Source Insight style code reading for C/C++, Java and Python: symbols, definition preview, calls, references and text search. Includes basic C indexing; full semantics require language extensions.
manifest.contributes.walkthroughs.0.desc: Keep your layout and keys. Enable classic reading presets when ready.
manifest.contributes.walkthroughs.0.step:
Read C offline. Full C++, Java and Python semantics require language extensions.

setting.indexCpuLimitPercent: Indexing CPU budget: 5–100% of logical CPU capacity; default 25%. Cooperative throttling, not an OS hard quota. Up to 32 parser workers plus a coordinator.
setting.indexMemoryLimitMb: Shared JavaScript heap and buffer budget for all local index threads (MiB), default 1024, further constrained by available system memory. Parser threads share this allowance. Pressure reduces concurrency or retains explicitly partial results; process memory growth is also monitored. V8 heap ceilings do not directly constrain WASM/SQLite or other VS Code components.
config.fileLoggingEnabled: Persist extension output, including index, query and error messages. Each window writes independently; files rotate at about 5 MiB with 3 backups. The Output panel remains available when disabled.
config.cacheDirectory: Extension cache root. Empty uses extension global storage. Projects have separate name-and-path-hash folders containing indexes and logs. Supports absolute paths, ~ and ${userHome}; the extension settings page provides a folder picker and resolved paths. Indexes and logs switch together; existing files are not moved or deleted. Remote windows use remote extension-host paths.
setting.indexMemoryMode: Memory budget mode. Fixed preserves the MiB limit; availablePercent uses currently available memory when starting workers and ignores the fixed MiB setting. Pressure checks remain active.
setting.indexMemoryAvailablePercent: Use 5–90% of available memory in percentage mode. Leaves at least 256 MiB or 2% of physical RAM (whichever is larger). This is a ceiling, not preallocation.
setting.projectSources: Index mode and scope: compilation database, imported files, or the entire workspace. Opening a workspace does not start indexing; use Start Indexing to choose a mode and start explicitly.
